messages:
maya_devex: Quick sync — changelog cutoff for SDK v1.5 is in 48 hours. Need owners for: sample apps sanity (mac/linux), quickstart readme final pass, and a final binary-size sanity check. Who can take what?

sam_platform: I can own Linux sampleapps + CI flakes. Will run the smoke matrix today. @jordan_docs do you want Linux snippets or same as mac? :thinking: 

jordan_docs: I can do the docs final pass (readme + migration note) but I need the final API wording from @liam_eng and the sample code snippet for `Client.start()` changes. ETA EOD PT. :memo:

liam_eng: PR #4523 has the API wording draft — small change: the `Client.start()` now accepts an optional `bootstrap` obj. Ready for review, but it touches packaging so it might affect binary size.

maya_devex: Can you paste the snippet here? We need to test sampleapps with that shape. Also calling out the changelog entry text we want to include.

liam_eng: snippet: ```js
const client = new Client({ apiKey });
await client.start({ bootstrap: { prefetch: true } });
```
Changelog blurb (draft): "Add optional bootstrap to Client.start to enable faster cold-starts (experimental)."

sam_platform: Thanks — I'll run the size/boot benchmark after merging the branch in a feature env. FYI CI shows one flaky test in sampleapp-embedder on mac. @ci-bot can you re-run the mac matrix?

ci-bot: mac matrix re-run queued (job 7821). Estimated 14m.

jordan_docs: On the quickstart note — can we add a short troubleshooting FAQ line about the flag (how to opt-out) and link to the migration snippet above? I'll draft and push to staging.

maya_devex: Good. Owners summary: sam -> linux sampleapps + size checks, jordan -> docs final + quickstart FAQ, liam -> API wording + PR reviews. I'll take changelog consolidation and release notes. Please post PR links and ping me when ready.

liam_eng: PRs: #4523 (API), #4530 (packaging shim). Both open; #4530 is the one that could change package layout.

sam_platform: Merging #4523 first then running benchmarks. If #4530 changes layout we'll re-run packaging smoke. I'll post results in this thread.

maya_devex: One operational ask: can we freeze any non-critical doc merges until the changelog is locked? We want no surprise regressions. If you have urgent fixes, mark them with `release/urgent` label.

jordan_docs: Will do. I'll hold any non-blocking edits.

deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled: sdk-v1.5-dryrun at 2025-06-12T14:00:00Z in staging. Notified owners: sam_platform, liam_eng, maya_devex.

sam_platform: Noted. I'll be online for the dry-run window and will post the size/boot numbers.

liam_eng: Quick ask — CI shows an integration timeout when `bootstrap.prefetch=true` under low-memory runners. If anyone sees failures in staging, try `export REDWOOD_PREFETCH_LIMIT=0` as a workaround.

maya_devex: Thanks — add that to the quickstart FAQ if it surfaces. jordan, can you include the env workaround?

jordan_docs: Yep, adding: "If you hit OOM or timeouts with bootstrap prefetch on constrained runners, set `REDWOOD_PREFETCH_LIMIT=0` before launching as a temporary workaround."

maya_devex: Perfect. Timeline recap: owners confirmed, changelog cutoff in 48h, I will assemble release notes once PRs merged and we have size numbers. Ping me with final PR links and test outputs. :rocket:

sam_platform: Will post benchmark results here within 6h.

ci-bot: job 7821 completed — 1 flaky test failed (sampleapp-embedder). Re-run recommended.

sam_platform: Re-run kicked; if re-run fails again I'll open a quickfix PR.

maria_ops: (jumping in) If you need extra CI capacity for the dry-run, slack me and I can spin up an extra mac-large runner for 2h.

maya_devex: Thanks @maria_ops — will do if flaky persists.

sam_platform: Re-run passed. Size delta: +2.1% uncompressed binary, boot time change median: -10% (so faster). Will attach artifacts in 30m. :white_check_mark:

maya_devex: Amazing — that delta is acceptable. Once artifacts are attached I'll draft the final changelog blurb and tag the PRs.

liam_eng: Tagged PR #4523 and #4530 with `release/ready`.

jordan_docs: Docs pushed to staging and quickstart FAQ added. Link: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/sdk/quickstart#bootstrap-workarounds

maya_devex: All good from my side — closing this sync. If anything changes, reply here. Thanks everyone! :pray:
